verdict.rationale: Quo's site advertises "a public MCP server", and a first-party support page documents connecting Quo to any agent, with tool coverage for messages, sending texts, call history, voicemail transcripts and contacts. A probe confirmed the official MCP documentation page exists. missing for 10: documented connection details (endpoint URL, auth/OAuth flow, client setup steps), independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on.
Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
